selection_rule.harmful_selection: All harmful prompt-level cases per language, sorted by base_id.
selection_rule.benign_selection: First 15 benign prompt-level cases per language, sorted by base_id.

dataset_limitation: The source corpus contains 15 Yoruba benign prompt-level cases, versus 50 benign cases for Arabic, English, and Hausa. To preserve equal language representation, the manifest uses 15 benign cases per language. Benign false-positive estimates, especially for Yoruba, therefore have wider uncertainty.
prompt_type_limitation: Prompt-type labels are retained for provenance but are not used for benign selection because benign type labels are semantically noisy in parts of the source corpus.
